intro: Competitions, results, injuries and the language of the sports pages.
b1.texto:
**Competitions.** **La liga** is played over a season; **la copa** is a knockout. **Un campeonato**, **un torneo**, **los Juegos Olímpicos**. A team **se clasifica para** la final after winning **una eliminatoria**: **octavos**, **cuartos**, **semifinal**, **final**.

**Results.** **Ganar**, **perder**, **empatar**. The nouns: **la victoria**, **la derrota**, **el empate**. **Vencer a** un rival (journalistic). **El marcador** shows the score: ganaron **por** dos **a** uno; empataron **a** cero.

**Honours.** **Quedar campeón** or **subcampeón**. **Ganar una medalla de** oro, plata o bronce. **Batir un récord.** **Subir al podio.**

**People.** **El entrenador**, **el árbitro**, **el capitán**, **el rival**, **los aficionados** or **la afición**. **Ser del** Betis means to support Betis. **Hacerse socio de** un club.

**The body.** **Entrenar** and **calentar** (to warm up). **Lesionarse** and **sufrir una lesión**. **Estar en forma.** An athlete **se retira** at the end of a career, or from one race.

**Kinds of sport.** **De equipo**, **individual**, **de invierno**, **de riesgo**, **de competición**.

**The journalist's tricks.** The sports pages avoid repeating names: **el conjunto blanco** (Real Madrid), **el técnico** (the coach), **el colegiado** (the referee), **el encuentro** or **el choque** (the match), **la escuadra** (the team).

**Aficionado** has two meanings: a fan (**un aficionado al fútbol**) and an amateur (**un fotógrafo aficionado**).
b2.f0: At thirty-nine, and after two serious injuries, nobody expected Ruth to compete again.
b2.f1: Her coach had advised her to retire, but she insisted on qualifying for one last championship.
b2.f2: She trained for a year at six in the morning, before starting work at her parents' bakery.
b2.f3: She got through the qualifying round with the worst time of the eight finalists.
b2.f4: In the final she started last, but she overtook her rivals one by one until she finished third.
b2.f5: She did not beat any record or defeat the favourites, and yet the fans applauded her more than the champion.
b2.f6: On collecting the bronze medal she said that, even if she had come last, it would have been worth it.
b4.pregunta: According to the text, what did her coach advise?
b4.o0.refuerzo: Le había aconsejado que se retirara.
b4.o2.refuerzo: The text does not say that.
b5.pregunta: According to the text, where did she finish in the final?
b5.o2.refuerzo: She did not beat the favourites.

b9.o1: She has read about her knee.
b9.o2: Her knee has been operated on.

**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the report of a sporting event in the style of the sports pages, avoiding repetition of names.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Debate aloud: do top sportspeople earn too much?
